Joe Montana's NFL Football.name: Joe Montana's NFL Football
Joe Montana's NFL Football.summary: This enhanced version of the Joe Montana series features 3D models and even full-motion video of Joe Montana himself. It sports a full NFL license with all 28 teams of the time with their respective nicknames and logos, along with 10 of the all-time greatest Super Bowl teams including '85 Bears, the '72 Dolphins, just to name a few, that the player can compete against if they win the biggest game of the year.

Puggsy.name: Puggsy
Puggsy.summary: Puggsy is no ordinary game. Using the unique system of Total Object Interaction (TOI), you have to guide Puggsy through some of the best puzzles and most frantic arcade action ever seen in his quest to retrieve his stolen spaceship. Incorporating graphic techniques never seen before, fantastic gameplay plus a complete Junior section for the younger player. Puggsy is destined to become the next world-wide smash hit.
